title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Payable Administrator

Salary: 27,000 - 30,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time Permanent

Our client is looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Payable Administrator to join their finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong accounts payable experience looking to join an established business in a varied finance and administration role.

The Role

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and matching them against purchase orders.
- Updating finance systems and ensuring accurate invoice coding.
- Preparing weekly supplier payment runs.
- Handling supplier queries and resolving invoice discrepancies.
- Assisting with credit card processing and reconciliations.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation.
- Supporting vehicle administration, including servicing, mileage claims and vehicle-related charges.
- Providing general finance and administrative support.

About You
- At least three years' experience in accounts payable.
- Experience processing supplier invoices and using finance systems.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.

Apply Today

If you're an experienced Accounts Payable Administrator, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Accounts Assistant or Finance Administrator looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are seeking an Account Assistant for a highly regarding Firm of Accountants in the West Kirby area.

This role is working with an interesting and diverse portfolio of clients from a wide range of sectors involving a mixture of Accounts, Tax, VAT, and Bookkeeping

The ideal candidate will have over 4 Years and current Accountancy Practice experience and are in the process of completing ACCA/ACA/AAT or QBE (Qualified by Experience)

Duties
- Preparation of statutory accounts for Sole Traders, Limited Companies and Partnerships
- Corporate/ Personal Tax Computations
- Preparation of VAT returns & bookkeeping
- Training clients on accountancy software
- Dealing with client queries
- Attending client meetings
- Assisting & mentoring junior staff

Please submit your application if you have the desired experience and a resident of the UK.

title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
My client is seeking an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Administrator to join their finance team in Birkenhead.The role will focus on processing supplier invoices and payments, assisting with credit card reconciliations and providing general administrative support, including vehicle administration.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Finance
- Process incoming supplier invoices, checking details against purchase orders and ensuring the correct references and cost codes are recorded.
- Obtain the necessary authorisations and process approved invoices through the relevant finance systems.
- Prepare and process weekly supplier payment runs.
- Respond to supplier queries professionally and promptly.
- Assist with credit card transaction processing and reconciliations.
- Provide general finance and administrative support as required.
- General Administration and Operational Support
- Answer incoming telephone calls and direct enquiries appropriately.
- Liaise with drivers and vehicle maintenance providers to arrange servicing and maintenance.
- Update vehicle insurance details when vehicles are exchanged.
- Check and process driver mileage claims.
- Maintain accurate records and up-to-date documentation.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- GCSEs or equivalent, including English and Maths at grade C/4 or above.
- At least three years' experience in an accounts payable role.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience using finance systems and processing supplier invoices.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and helpful approach when dealing with colleagues, suppliers and external contacts.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

This role offers a basic salary of up to £29,000 depending on experience, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, company pension, death in service

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Location: Wirral

Salary: Up tp £32,000 DOE

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

An established and well-respected accountancy practice on the Wirral is seeking a Bookkeeper to join it's growing team.

As a Bookkeeper, you will be responsible for managing day-to-day financial records and assisting with the preparation of client accounts. You'll work closely with managers and clients, ensuring accurate and timely financial informtation is maintained.

Key Responsibilites
- Bookkeeping for a portfolio of clients
- Processing sales and purchase invoices
- Bank reconciliations
- VAT return preparation and submission
- Managing client records using cloud-based software
- Assisting with the preparation of management accounts
- Processing payroll information where required
- Liaising directly with clients and responding to queries
- Supporting the wider accounts team with ad hoc duties

About You
- Previous bookkeeping or accounts experience within an accountancy practice
- Experience preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Excellent communication skills and client-focused approach
- AAT qualified or studying towards AAT qualificatiion would be advantageous
- Ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines

Apply Now

If you're a Bookkeeper or Accounts Assistant looking to join a reputable accountancy practice where your contribution will be valued and your career can progress, we'd love to hear from you. Apply here or contact Liz Chapman at Reed today.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Salary: Circa £28,000 FTE

Permanent Full-time or potentially part-time

Experienced in Credit Control? Looking for a fresh opportunity?

Hoot Recruit is recruiting on behalf of an established business looking for a Credit Controller to join its finance team.

We're looking for someone who knows their way around credit control, enjoys dealing with customers and is confident chasing payments while maintaining good working relationships.

You'll be joining an experienced team, working alongside an existing Credit Controller who will be on hand to provide guidance and support as they move into another position within the business.

What you'll be doing
- Managing outstanding customer payments
- Contacting customers by phone and email to chase overdue invoices
- Maintaining accurate records of payments and outstanding balances
- Resolving invoice and payment queries
- Building positive relationships with customers
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Working closely with the wider finance team to keep debtor balances under control

What we're looking for
- Previous credit control experience is essential
- Confident and professional telephone manner
- Comfortable having conversations about overdue payments
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Friendly, approachable and proactive attitude

What's on offer?
- Salary circa £28,000 (pro rata for part-time)
- Permanent opportunity
- Potential flexibility around working hours
- Part-time hours may be considered, ideally spread across five days
- Support from an experienced finance team
- Stable, established business

This could be a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who wants a role where they can make a real contribution without necessarily having to manage a team.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
This is an excellent opportunity for a Finance Assistant with strong Excel skills and finance administration experience who is looking to develop their career within a busy, supportive and fast-paced environment. You'll gain exposure across multiple group entities, work closely with experienced finance professionals, and play an important role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the finance function.

Client Details

The business based near the Wirral offers genuine opportunities for learning and development, making it an ideal move for someone looking to build on existing finance experience and progress their career.

Description

As Finance Assistant, you'll support the wider finance team across a range of transactional and accounting activities, including:
- Daily bank postings and reconciliations
- Purchase ledger reconciliations and invoice processing
- Sales ledger reconciliation support
- Posting invoices and credit notes onto the finance system
- Preparing monthly reports and spreadsheets
- Assisting with reconciliations and month-end finance activities
- Investigating and resolving account and variance queries
- Liaising with internal departments to ensure accurate financial reporting
- Supporting the finance team with ad-hoc projects and process improvements

Profile

The relevant Finance Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in a finance, accounts or transactional finance role
- Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUPs
- Experience working with large volumes of data
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving
- Confidence using Microsoft Office applications and finance systems
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
- A positive attitude and desire to learn and develop

Job Offer

Our client will offer you:
- Salary up to £28,000 DOE
- Performance-related bonus
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Hybrid working (3 days office-based, including Fridays)
- 5% matched pension contribution
- Excellent training and development opportunities
- Modern offices with fantastic facilities
- Additional wellbeing and lifestyle benefits
- Opportunity to join a growing and successful business with long-term career prospects

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
As a Purchase Ledger professional in Wirral, you will manage purchase ledger tasks that help the Accounting & Finance department keep supplier records and payments organised. Working in the FMCG, Fast Moving Consumer Goods industry, you will help maintain clear and accurate financial information during this temporary assignment.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the FMCG, Fast Moving Consumer Goods industry on the Wirral.

Description
- Process supplier invoices accurately and keep purchase ledger records up to date.
- Match invoices to relevant purchase information and resolve basic discrepancies.
- Maintain supplier account details to support accurate payment records.
- Prepare purchase ledger information for payment processing.
- Respond to supplier queries and provide clear updates on account information.
- Review outstanding invoice items and follow up where further details are needed.
- Keep finance records well organised to support day-to-day Accounting & Finance activity.

Profile

A successful 'Purchase Ledger' should have:
- Experience handling purchase ledger records and supplier invoices.
- Confidence matching invoices with purchase information and checking details.
- Ability to maintain accurate data across supplier accounts.
- Experience dealing with invoice queries in a clear and timely way.
- Good attention to detail when reviewing financial documents.
- Ability to organise workload and keep records up to date.

Job Offer
- Temporary Purchase Ledger assignment.
- Location: Wirral.
